decision_rule: Ask for municipality GPS landmark and nearest source before field routing unless emergency hotline is needed.
examples: garbage not collected no town; smoke smell somewhere
notes: Location drives both municipal and environmental response.

decision_rule: Route routine collection overflowing bins and street sweeping to the resolved municipality.
examples: zbele not collected in Zahle; overflowing bins in Tripoli
notes: Do not route routine local collection to MOE by default.

decision_rule: Route local illegal dumping to municipality but keep HITL for scale hazardous indicators or environmental violation.
examples: truck dumped trash on public land; makab 3ashwa2i
notes: MOE becomes primary when hazardous industrial or regulatory pollution is present.

decision_rule: Route hazardous/medical/chemical/industrial waste to MOE with local municipality context and HITL.
examples: medical waste near clinic; chemical barrels dumped
notes: Hazard class and source need confirmation.

decision_rule: Civil Defense is first for active fire or smoke danger; municipality/MOE follow after scene safety.
examples: landfill fire; garbage burning in dump; makab on fire

decision_rule: Route suspected industrial pollution to MOE and keep municipality as location/context secondary.
examples: factory smoke; chemical smell from plant; ma3mal dumping

decision_rule: Route river/stream pollution to MOE; keep HITL for utility sewage irrigation or municipal source boundary.
examples: oil in river; Litani discharge; nahr polluted
notes: Not the same as potable water outage routing.

decision_rule: Route quarry/crusher environmental complaints to MOE with municipal context and HITL.
examples: crusher dust; illegal quarry noise; ksara pollution
notes: MoEW mine/quarry context may matter but MOE is environmental complaint channel.

decision_rule: Use ISF for threat violence or public-order danger; environmental cleanup follows after safety.
examples: armed dumping crew; threat when reporting waste
notes: Criminal/security layer is separate from environmental enforcement.
